title: Agenda container images manifest
description: Pinned container image references shared between the Aspire AppHost and the build pipeline. This file is the single source of truth: every image used by the AppHost MUST be declared here, and every entry MUST be referenced by the AppHost. Renovate watches this file to bump tags.

images.description: Map of logical image keys (used by the AppHost code) to their pinned reference.

image.description: Image repository as accepted by Aspire's WithImage(...) — without registry and without tag.

tag.description: Pinned tag. MUST NOT be 'latest' or empty so Renovate can compare versions.
